lessons.objective: Learner can understand, explain and apply प्रकृति.
teaching_sequence: Begin with an original short example connected to the learner's life.
Ask what the learner notices before giving formal explanation.
Model how to use textual clues or context.
Guide one response, then remove support.
Ask for an original example or retelling.
lessons.checkpoint: Explain प्रकृति without notes and solve a new example.
